findings.title: `adoptionStateWrites: 'read-only'` in 2.2 is a no-op for the captured cases
findings.description: The golden capture passes `{ adoptionStateWrites: 'read-only' }`, but the two fixtures (greenfield and already-planned) do not trigger adoption logic, so the option has no effect on the captured output. The "for now" wording in the task may mislead a junior implementer into thinking the option matters for byte-identity. Functionally harmless — the golden still reflects post-cut behavior — but worth knowing in case the implementer spends time investigating.
